title: Filter GET /api/tickets by status and return 400 on an unknown status
evidence: reports/round-1.md: listed as open item F2, not selected in round 1
observed: GET /api/tickets?status=open ignores the status parameter and returns every ticket, including closed ones. The support dashboard polls this endpoint every 30 seconds and pages through hundreds of closed tickets.
expected: When status is given, only tickets with that status are returned. When status is given but is not a known status, the API returns 400 with a message, not an empty list. When status is absent, behaviour is unchanged. Open point for the spec-writer, which is a contract decision for a person: use the 400 error shape of B2 (an `errors` map) or the PATCH shape (`error` plus `allowed`). Round 1 flagged this.
